Appendix E — Lifestyle & Condition Question Bank

The full engine-ready intake bank: 354 questions grouped by 1 content sections × 3 phases (onboarding → progressive → ongoing), covering 125 conditions. Each question has a stable reference code DOM-NNN — 3-letter domain code + sequence within section, a place in the progressive chain (prerequisites → this → unlocks, with prev/next links), an applicability vector (sex · age · life-stage · persona) and signed weights onto the 12 pillars and MONIAC reservoirs. The LIFE stream (Doc 07); validated PROs are in Appendix C.

Illustrative
All bands, weights and cut-points on this page are literature/guideline-anchored examples and must be re-verified and cohort-adjusted before any production use (Conventions §5.6). This is design documentation, not a validated medical device.
Answer → score → nudge → adherence, and the question chain
flowchart LR
  PRQ["prerequisite Qs"] --> Q["this question (ref)"] --> UNL["unlocked Qs"]
  Q --> M["response: direction · magnitude · signed weight"]
  M --> P["pillar Δrisk (Doc 03)"]
  M --> R["reservoir inflow (Doc 04)"]
  P --> PS(("PureScore"))
  R --> PS
  PS --> N["top-5 nudges (Doc 11/12)"] --> AD["adherence"] --> R
  PS --> PA["perceived vs actual (Appendix F)"]
Reference & chain
ref = 3-letter section code + sequence (e.g. CMB-001); order = global intake position; prerequisites/unlocks = the dependency DAG (sex/age/gender gating + show_if + triggers); applicability = {sex · age · life-stage · personas}. Machine-readable source: data/question-bank.json (rebuild via data/enrich_bank.py).
↑ risk / adds burden↓ risk / builds reserveneutralP1 = ask first♀/♂ = sex-specific⛓ prerequisite chain
